'''E-5KL''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] owned by the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Frelka]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What?! I don't want people meddling in my business! Heh. It's about time I dismantled that droid. Oh well... thanks anyway. Here, kid.|Frelka, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Frelka's Folly|Station Gamma!}}</ref>}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Frelka and E-5KL visited the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. They resided in [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that they used as a starting point to explore [[Station Gamma]], an [[asteroid base]] nearby.<ref name="SWG:F" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Frelka and E-5KL flew out to Station Gamma to get treasure but they realized that the station had been taken oven by the [[Rak'qua]], a tribe of aggressive [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]]. While exploring, Frelka ran into a member of the [[Rak'qua]], the pair fought and Frelka lost causing him to flee the station back to Tansarii, in his haste leaving behind E-5KL.<ref name="SWG:F" /> Frelka later met a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who he asked to head back to Station Gamma and find his droid for him.<ref name="SWG:TSG" /> The spacer then traveled to Station Gamma where E-5KL told him of Frelka's defeat and asked the spacer to kill the Rak'qua Aphotic who humiliated Frelka. The spacer did so and returned to Frelka to inform him of te death of his foe and the safety of his droid. However, Frelka reluctantly thanked the spacer as he wanted to have kept his defeat a secret and ungratefully claimed he might scrap E-5KL.<ref name="SWG:FF" />

==Behind the scenes==
E-5KL was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TSG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> E-5KL was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
